description: Defines classes and constants for Oblivious HTTP header key configuration, including key serialization, parsing, and management of multiple key configurations within the quiche namespace.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig
classes.description: Represents a single Oblivious HTTP header key configuration, including key ID, cryptographic scheme IDs, and serialization/parsing methods.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs
classes.description: Manages multiple Oblivious HTTP header key configurations and associated public keys, supporting creation, parsing, and selection of preferred configs.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs::SymmetricAlgorithmsConfig
classes.description: Defines a set of symmetric algorithms (kdf_id and aead_id) used in key configurations.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs::OhttpKeyConfig
classes.description: Represents a key configuration including key ID, kem ID, public key, and supported symmetric algorithms.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig instance with specified IDs.

methods.name: SerializeRecipientContextInfo
methods.description: Serializes the context info for HPKE in network byte order.

methods.name: ParseOhttpPayloadHeader
methods.description: Parses and verifies the Oblivious HTTP payload header from bytes or a data reader.

methods.name: ParseKeyIdFromObliviousHttpRequestPayload
methods.description: Extracts the key ID from an Oblivious HTTP request payload.

methods.name: GenerateConcatenatedKeys
methods.description: Generates a byte string of all configured keys for the 'application/ohttp-keys' media type.

methods.name: PreferredConfig
methods.description: Returns the key configuration with the highest key ID.

methods.name: GetPublicKeyForId
methods.description: Retrieves the public key associated with a given key ID.
